providers.title: Greedy over a base
providers.scope: Keeping the labels of Z not spanned by P and the kept ones gives a set independent over P, of size rk(Z | P), spanning Z over P.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Greedy is optimal
providers.scope: Priority greedy finds an independent set of maximum weight.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One sample suffices (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Against an adversary who sees all samples, values and coins, a fixed rule earns at least 2^-293 times the expected optimum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fixed-vector guarantee
providers.scope: For a hidden weight vector, sacrificing revealed labels, the expected worst-order reward is at least 2^-293 OPT.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One-sample simulation
providers.scope: Samples on the sacrificed set and values elsewhere form a vector with the law of the values, independent of the seed.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The maximum rule
providers.scope: A fair mask used as a threshold makes the most valuable label accepted with probability at least 1/4 in every order.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Candidate mass
providers.scope: Labels not spanned by more valuable masked labels carry expected rounded weight at most W, and contain an independent set of expected weight W/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Density expansion
providers.scope: The largest maximizer of revealed count minus kappa times rank above a flat is increasing; further rank captures at most kappa revealed labels per unit.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Path properties
providers.scope: Nested increasing paths of flats; every nonloop is born at the activation time or at a time whose base two steps earlier is enabled.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Generator budget
providers.scope: A whole nominal path is generated over the lighter path by at most |D_h|/kappa revealed labels.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Feasibility
providers.scope: Greedy selection within layers of nested flats is independent after every prefix, for every order.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Order-uniform rank bound
providers.scope: In every order, acceptances of weight at least that of a group are at least its layer rank statistic.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Telescoping rank cost
providers.scope: Replacing the nominal path by the final path costs at most the group's guards and the guards and generators of heavier groups.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Disjoint certificates
providers.scope: Adaptive reads of independent bits yield at most log(1/delta) disjoint positive certificates of an increasing event in expectation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exit mass
providers.scope: Read backwards, a label leaves its nominal path at a step with exit probability at least eta with probability more than 1/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Containment
providers.scope: The hybrid step contains the density expansion of the layer base together with all lighter competitors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Safe samples (OpenAI)
providers.scope: In expectation at least eta/4 of the revealed comparison labels of a group are safe, up to |D_h|/kappa.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sign patterns
providers.scope: n affine functions on R^d have at most sum over l <= d of C(n, l) strict sign patterns.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Marked pivots (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Inserting at most s occurrences into a marked sequence yields at most 4^s times sum over l <= s of C(n, l) pivot-mark vectors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Residual family
providers.scope: All residuals of a group of size n lie in a family of size exp(1000 n log(kappa)/kappa), fixed before the group's masks.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sample-to-rank transfer (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For groups of size at least kappa, the expected unrevealed rank is at least (gamma |Y_i| - 2^-23 n_i)/kappa.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Minimum over orders
providers.scope: For every seed the worst-order rounded reward is at least half the weighted sum of the layer statistics.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Secretary rule with an adversarial suffix
providers.scope: After a random observed prefix, any suffix order chosen with full knowledge leaves expected reward at least 2^-293 OPT.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
